summary: Ryde Group Ltd filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement covering an at-the-market offering of up to $96,399,000 of Class A ordinary shares under a Sales Agreement dated October 9, 2026 with Arc Group Securities LLC as sales agent. Shares trade on NYSE American under RYDE, closing at US$0.6810 on October 6, 2026. The agent earns a 2.5% gross commission and sells on a commercially reasonable efforts basis, with no escrow. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution and any accelerated selling pressure on the stock.
